text:
neha (PM): Quick sync — drafting the DP enlistment contract for the private beta starting in 6 weeks. Need alignment on commitment window, feedback cadence, and launch kill criteria.
ben (Eng): +1. We should require a minimum integration surface so we can gather meaningful latency/cost signals — at least 2 routes hitting the API.
kai (ML): Agree on routes. Also want a list of 3 canonical prompts per partner so evals are comparable.
lucy (Design): From UX side — a 5‑minute onboarding checklist and a short in-product feedback button. Keep the survey < 6 questions.
marco (Solutions): For customers, commitment is a big ask. Can we make it a 4 week minimum with an opt-out after 2 weeks if integration blockers are on our side?
neha (PM): Proposal: 4 week minimum usage, weekly feedback touchpoints, plus a mandatory end-of-beta evaluation. If Redwood misses SLA or onboarding >7 days delayed, partner may opt-out without penalty. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
ben (Eng): Sounds fair. For metrics we need: avg p95 latency, tokens per request, error rate, and fallback rate. Weekly dump to a shared bucket + short summary doc.
kai (ML): Add quality metrics: automated BLEU/ROUGE-like compare for structured outputs where applicable + human-rated accuracy on 20 sample responses.
lucy (Design): I'll draft the 6 question end-of-beta survey. Quick idea: ease_of_integration 1-5, correctness 1-5, latency satisfaction 1-5, value 1-5, blockers free text, net_promoter_score.
marco (Solutions): Incentive structure suggestion: extended free Dedicated credits (2 months) for partners who complete all feedback loops and submit 3 regression test prompts. Otherwise standard credits.
legal-bot: Heads up — need a one-way NDA + data handling clause. No PII in shared eval sets; redact or mark. Also require a data retention period (30 days default, negotiable).
neha (PM): Good catch. We'll include: NDA, PII clause, retention 30d, and opt-in for log access.
ben (Eng): Operationally: can we add an 'incident playbook' doc for partners? If they see a regression, they can trigger a rollback or open a high-priority support ticket.
ops-bot: Note: create a dedicated Slack channel per partner for incident triage and weekly syncs. I'll provision channels after sign-up.
kai (ML): Launch kill criteria (our side): if model regression >10% on partner's critical prompts or p95 latency >2x SLA for 3 consecutive days, automatic pause & notify partner. Partner kill criteria: if customer-facing UX impact or >20% error rate for 2 days, they can pause.
neha (PM): Let's make those explicit in the enlistment doc. Also add an escalation ladder: SRE -> Product -> Partner lead -> Exec.
lucy (Design): For feedback collection: in-product button should capture route, prompt hash, and allow screenshot + free text. Keep payload small.
marco (Solutions): We need to standardize the prompt hash scheme so partners can map their prompts to our evals without sending content. Suggest SHA1(prefix + prompt_norm).
ben (Eng): Example onboarding checklist I'll add to the doc: 1) API key provisioned, 2) 2 routes instrumented with tracing, 3) 3 canonical prompts registered, 4) weekly digest enabled.
neha (PM): OK — action items: lucy draft survey + in-product UX (due EOW), ben add checklist + metrics spec (EOW), kai write eval rubric + regression thresholds (EOW), marco draft partner incentive wording (Mon), legal-bot to prepare NDA stub (Mon), ops-bot to automate channel provisioning (Mon).
marco (Solutions): One more ask — can we offer partners a short onboarding session (30m) recorded for reuse? Helps reduce friction.
neha (PM): Yes. We'll schedule a 30m onboarding and record. Include a roster field in the signup form for attendees.
ben (Eng): Concern — some partners will game the minimum traffic requirement. Suggest we require synthetic traffic generation step during first 48 hours so we can validate instrumentation.
kai (ML): +1 to synthetic warmup. Also lock a small sample cache so partners see consistent latency in first run.
lucy (Design): On rollout comms — please don't call it "beta" externally. Use "private preview" in customer-facing materials. Internal docs can say beta.
neha (PM): Noted. Final check: opt-out process — partner emails dp-ops@redwood with reason, ops reviews within 48 hours and confirms. If opt-out triggered because of Redwood breach of onboarding SLA, waive any penalties.
legal-bot: Also require partners to certify they won't export model outputs to disallowed jurisdictions. Add short checkbox in signup form.
neha (PM): Great. I'll assemble the enlistment JSON and sample survey and drop it here for review before EOW. Quick poll: thumbs up to the commitment + incentive structure? :thumbsup: :thumbsdown:
ben (Eng): :thumbsup:
kai (ML): :thumbsup:
lucy (Design): :thumbsup:
marco (Solutions): :thumbsup:
legal-bot: :thumbsup:
neha (PM): Thanks all — I'll post the draft file shortly.
